# Explore the schema

tables = pd.read_sql_query(query, conn)
print("Tables in database:")
print(tables)

# Get schema of workday__organization_overview table

schema = pd.read_sql_query(schema_query, conn)
print("\nSchema of workday__organization_overview table:")
print(schema)

# Read a sample of the data to understand column types
sample_query = "SELECT * FROM workday__organization_overview LIMIT 5;"
sample_data = pd.read_sql_query(sample_query, conn)
print("\nSample data (first 5 rows):")

# Distinguish column types
print("\nColumn types:")
print(sample_data.dtypes)

non_numeric_cols = sample_data.select_dtypes(exclude=[np.number]).columns
print("\nNumeric columns:", list(numeric_cols))
print("Non-numeric columns:", list(non_numeric_cols))

conn.close()
